text:
Day 1

Getting started (10 min)

  • Logging into CLUE & getting started

Investigate (15 min)

  • Motions to pick things up (5 min)
  • Figuring out what muscles make them (10 min)

Design (10 min)

  • Read about characters and decide which their team will focus on (7 min)
  • Look at gripper prototype suggestions and decide which they will make (3 min)

Develop (20 min - remainder of class)

  • Start working on gripper prototype (17 min)
  • Write brief notes to figure out where to get started next time and what modification they might make (3 min)

Day 2

Develop (25 mins)

  • Finish up prototype

Evaluate (30 mins)

  • Evaluate prototype (3 mins)
  • Gallery walk (15 mins)
  • Their own ideas about criteria for good prototypes (2 mins)
  • Discussion about criteria for good prototypes (10 mins)
